title: THE ANSWER LINE STAYS OFF THE BUTTONS
why: His note after playing: the UI and the messages are not as clean as they should be. In the pictures, the one-line answer at the bottom of the screen (TROPHY EARNED, The welcome pack is in your stash.) sat on top of ASCEND TO THIS SECTOR on the map select screen, hiding the button words, and on the Undercroft floor it sat on the middle cells of the tactical belt. It rides under the heading on the map select screen now, and above the belt on the floor and in a raid.
now: The answer line no longer covers ASCEND TO THIS SECTOR or the tactical belt.
